tasks.short: Provide professional consulting services to government or industry

steps.what: Read the consulting request from government or industry
Meet the client and record the constraints they stated
Write the advice points, the audience and the cited sources
Place only those advice points under the client's question headings
Check the advice draft adds no point she did not write
Send only the accepted advice note to the external client

tasks.design: She meets the client, then writes the advice points, the question headings and the sources in {DOCS}. A copy places only those points under the headings and does not wait to be checked. She checks that the draft adds no point, and only the accepted note is sent once by {EMAIL}. A rejection sends nothing.
tasks.previous_blocker: The advice note was one write, so placing her points under the client's headings was not split from the advice.
tasks.enabler_now: The client's question headings are a fixed list. Copying points she already wrote into them needs no model and adds no sentence.
tasks.still_hard: The meeting and the advice stay hers. A request with no headings cannot be filled by the copy.
tasks.human_edge: She decides what to tell the client, and she rejects a draft that adds a point.
tasks.altitude: The heading copy and the send leave her week. She still meets the client, writes the advice points, and accepts or rejects the note before it is sent.

reach.task: Name the curriculum question this consultation answers
reach.learn: Which curriculum question is hers to answer, and which the coordinator already owns

evidence.claim: Placing advice points she wrote under question headings the client named adds no advice. This is model knowledge.
She accepts the note before any send, so the outgoing note is not produced solely by software. This is model knowledge.

assumptions: She writes the advice and sends it today, so the copy and the send keep her as the actor. The machine is only the future of those two steps.
Structured fields she writes before the copy: advice points (sentences she wrote), question headings (taken from the request), cited sources (titles she names). A blank point list produces no draft.
The copy places only those fields. It does not compose a sentence and it does not wait for its own check.
The note is not uploaded to an external model. The send is one email of the accepted note. A change to the draft voids the acceptance. A rejection sends nothing.
Upkeep hours are zero. A draft she rejects is dropped in the check, and there is no later rewrite queue.
unknowns: Which extra fields a ministry or a firm asks for beyond the question headings and her points.
research_questions: Which fields does this client require beyond the question headings and the points she wrote?

already_counted.description: The check that the draft adds no point, already in the review before the send.

incremental.description: A rejected draft is dropped in the check. There is no later rewrite queue, so upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: requests that name no question headings, so she writes and sends the note herself and the copy rarely runs. High: requests whose headings match points she already wrote, so the copy and the one send happen, while the meeting, the points and the check stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The meeting and the advice stay in her week. Only placing stated points under headings and sending the accepted note leave it. She gains no new decision right.
skills_to_grow: Write the advice points before any heading copy.
Treat a heading copy as layout, not as the advice.
Keep the meeting and the decision to send in her own hands.
role.ambitious_version: The week does not grow. She does not take more consulting work because a note can be assembled and sent.

job.title: English Language and Literature Teachers, Postsecondary
